name: fb_first_mac_dropped
subs:
R(3) = rd32(a, sp - 4u);              /* the slot at +12 */
    F(3) = F(3);

name: fb_second_mac_dropped
subs:
fload(a, 2, R(3));                    /* FR2: the slot at +12 */
    F(3) = fmac(a, F(0), F(2), F(3));

fload(a, 2, R(3));                    /* FR2: the slot at +12 */
    F(3) = F(3);

name: fb_slot0_uses_slot2
subs:
/* and back into the slot at +0 */
    fstore(a, 3, R(6));

/* and back into the slot at +0 */
    fstore(a, 3, R(7));

name: fb_array_second_load_off
subs:
/* the array's second float, into the slot at +4 */
    fload(a, 3, R(4));

/* the array's second float, into the slot at +4 */
    fload(a, 3, R(4) + 4u);
